name: Copyright-Bench
description: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform commercial tasks that involve retrieving external content, such as images, and, where appropriate, reproducing that content. LLM agents should comply with the law, including copyright law. Presently, however, we lack adequate frameworks to assess whether they do so in practice. To that end, we introduce Copyright-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents' compliance with copyright law.
